title: "How long should it fly for when optimised?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
# Both designs, then the tabulated one re-trimmed through the exact network so
# that one set of aerodynamics judges both.
result = tabulated_penalty(section_table())
exact, claimed, flown = result["exact"], result["claimed"], result["flown"]
lost = exact["duration"] - flown["duration"]

assert claimed["duration"] > exact["duration"]  # the table flatters its own pick
assert flown["duration"] < exact["duration"]    # and the pick is worse in fact
assert lost > 0.5                               # by more than a second of flight
```

`{python} f"{lost:.2f}"` s, `{python} f"{lost / exact['duration']:.0%}"` of the
answer.
